    "Flexible structure adapts well to evolving research workflows"

    "Can have a steep learning curve to master its full potential",
    "Performance can occasionally be slow with complex pages or many linked databases",
    "Mobile experience is not always as robust as the desktop version"
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This postdoctoral researcher likely found Notion to be an incredibly powerful and versatile tool for managing their research projects and tasks. Its high degree of customization allowed them to tailor it precisely to their unique organizational needs, consolidating various aspects of their work. While the initial learning curve might have been a challenge, the long-term benefits of its flexibility and all-in-one nature made it an indispensable part of their workflow."
